POC details / acceptance criteria:
- Workload: in-product chat support + doc search embeddings for help articles.
- Throughput targets: steady state 20-40 rps; peak bursts up to 120 rps for short windows.
- Latency SLO: p95 < 350ms for chat generation (95% of requests), p99 < 800ms acceptable for large contexts.
- Cost targets: target < $300-$350 per 1M tokens for production model mix.
- Quality guardrails: automated eval suite against 150 prompt/response pairs; no >7% regression on key metrics (accuracy/relevance).

Cost optimization focus areas agreed in workshop:
- Batching strategy: session-aware batching for chat to enable per-session prefix reuse while keeping latency bounds; aim to reduce per-token compute by 18-30% on steady-state.
- KV/prefix caching: cache embeddings and KV for frequent help article lookups; expected 10-25% token reduction for common flows.
- Quantization profiles: evaluate int8 and dynamic int4 for candidate open models; prepare quality vs throughput matrix. SE to run quantized inference on Dedicated trial nodes.
- Model routing & fallback: implement policy to send high-priority traffic to higher-cost low-latency model variant and background rerank requests to cheaper model. Economics sheet to capture weighted mix.
- Autoscaling & burst capacity: test Dedicated reserved baseline + burst to hosted capacity for traffic spikes.
